title: Navimower 0.4.1-beta6

## Passive discovery startup hotfix

Beta5 introduced **Passive protocol discovery**, but its MQTT bridge referenced `OPT_PASSIVE_DISCOVERY` without importing that constant from `const.py`. This caused Navimower config entries to fail during setup before MQTT could start.

- Import `OPT_PASSIVE_DISCOVERY` in `mqtt.py`, restoring normal config-entry startup for all mowers.
- Add a regression contract that parses the MQTT bridge and verifies both passive-discovery constants are imported before a release can pass CI.
- Keep the beta5 Passive protocol discovery feature unchanged: it remains opt-in and off by default.
- Keep beta4 pose-degraded recovery and beta3 raw-first telemetry behaviour unchanged.

Beta6 supersedes the withdrawn beta5 prerelease. Users who installed beta5 should update to beta6 and restart or reload Navimower.
